description: Africa - Power Stations is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Power Stations in Africa 2012 Created in 2012 from unknown source. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy access, Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2012 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
